releaseNotes: Extracted the founder web product to its own private repository (layering plan phase C; R2, R9; founder decisions 1-2). Formation-Platform now carries the platform with full history (git subtree split), its own toolchain, the six platform docs, an engine pin (engine.pin.json at v0.151.1 with scripts/sync-engine.sh + check-engine-version.mjs failing on pin drift or a contract-major mismatch), and a CI that replays this repository's golden adapter-contract samples against the consumer's own acceptance logic — 258/258 tests green against the vendored engine before cutover. The hosted instance at formation.clueless.clothing was repointed to the new checkout and verified serving (local and public health 200) BEFORE platform/ was deleted here — deploy-then-delete, uptime preserved.

This repository is now engine-only: platform/, docs/platform/, and the platform CI workflow are gone; README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/architecture.md, and the engine backlog describe the platform as an external, contract-bound consumer; the source registry retires the two entries served from the platform's public assets; the ste100 governed-doc list keeps only engine-side docs, with its scans-the-allowlist fixture repointed at a doc that stays. The adapter CLIs (core/adapters/platform-execution.ts, platform-import.ts) remain engine-side, proven by the golden samples. The standing rule holds mechanically now: L4 never lives in this repository.
